name: The Crown of Will
summary: Only one step remains: the Crown is bound for Sharlindra in the Undercity, who will see that it reaches Lady Sylvanas.

sections.title: To the Undercity
sections.body: Melisara sends you to take the Crown to Sharlindra in the Undercity, where she will pass it on to Lady Sylvanas. She warns you not to use it for your own purposes. Mug'Thol's fate is warning enough.

sections.title: Sharlindra's Reaction
sections.body: Sharlindra recognizes the Crown as the relic the ogre used to escape the Dark Lady's will. She finds it odd that so plain an object held such power, and that it fell into such clumsy hands. Sharlindra will take it to Lady Sylvanas and tell her what you did.

faq.q: Who receives the Crown of Will in the Undercity?
aliases: where do i take the crown
faq.answer: Sharlindra receives the Crown in the Undercity. Melisara says she will see that Lady Sylvanas gets it.

faq.q: Why does Melisara warn against using the crown?
aliases: why not use crown of will
faq.answer: Melisara warns you not to use the Crown for your own ends. She points to Mug'Thol's fate as warning enough.

faq.q: Who sends you with the crown?
faq.answer: Melisara sends you with the Crown as the fifth and final part, after the fourth.
